note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Butte Ranger District), on the east side of the Highland Mountains close to a creek, in a quiet forest setting. From Butte about 18 mi on MT-2 (15 mi west of Whitehall), then about 3 mi on FR 240 (Radar Creek Rd), a gravel road the Forest Service calls suitable for passenger vehicles; elev ~5890 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Sept 1, 2026): confirmed 5 units for trailers to 22 ft, vault toilet, no potable water, FCFS, 16-day limit, no fee. Added season (typically Memorial Day-Labor Day; Seasons of Use May to mid September).
